_notes: Agency console: imperative, dense; 'fáze' = stage, 'případ' = case, 'čeká se na' = waiting on, 'úložiště dokumentů' = document vault (replaced the one 'trezor'), 'kontrola' = review (document/essay), 'poradce' = counselor, 'odpovědná osoba' = owner. 'pipeline' kept as the agency CRM term already used in cs/agency.json.

University console: formal; 'uchazeč' = applicant, 'posouzení' = review, 'nabídka' = offer, 'zápis' = enrollment. university:v22.stage.received changed from 'Přijato' to 'Doručeno' because 'Přijato/Přijatí' collides with Admitted.
'standard admission letter' = 'standardní dopis o přijetí' (chips: 'dopis o přijetí'); 'vízum D-2/D-4' kept official.
Console names kept as the existing 'Konzole agentury' / 'Konzole univerzity'; 'Hangyul HQ' = 'Centrála Hangyul', 'Hangyul Operations' = 'Provoz Hangyul' (matches common:role.HANGYUL_OPERATIONS).
Czech CLDR plurals: _one/_few/_many/_other supplied for every family where the job had only _one/_other (or only _other); _many is the fractional reading (genitive singular).
agency:v27.evidence.ageDays rendered as '{{count}} d' (same as docs.durDays) because the bare key has no plural forms and 'před {{count}} dny' would be wrong for 1.
ws.assignedBy rendered 'Přiřazeno: {{by}}' so that the ws.by.* values (nominative noun phrases) read correctly after it.
Gendered labels (Přijel(a), Zapsán(a), Přiřazen) kept as the file already does; owner may prefer gender-neutral forms.
